pairs: The Lord is great and exceedingly praiseworthy,
in the city of our God,
Fundatur exsultatione universæ terræ mons Sion;
Mount Zion is being founded with the exultation of the whole earth,
the city of the great king.
Deus in domibus ejus cognoscetur cum suscipiet eam.
In her houses, God will be known, since he will support her.
Quoniam ecce reges terræ congregati sunt;
For behold, the kings of the earth have been gathered together;
Trembling took hold of them. In that place,
their pains were that of a woman in labor.
in spiritu vehementi conteres naves Tharsis.
With a vehement spirit, you will crush the ships of Tarshish.
in the city of the Lord of hosts,
in the city of our God.
God has founded it in eternity.
misericordiam tuam in medio templi tui.
in the midst of your temple.
sic et laus tua in fines terræ;
so does your praise reach to the ends of the earth.
Your right hand is full of justice.
and let the daughters of Judah exult,
Ponite corda vestra in virtute ejus,
Set your hearts on her virtue.
so that you may discourse of it in another generation.
in eternity and forever and ever.
